title: Common Definitions (v1)
description: Shared $defs reused across the v1 schema set. This file has no instance-level type and is only ever consumed via $ref.

Sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hex-encoded SHA-256 digest of the exact byte content it identifies (asset content or full raw release image).

SafeId.description: Filesystem- and URL-safe identifier. Matches internal/config.IsSafeID: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$, plus tooling additionally rejects reserved Windows device names case-insensitively (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-9, LPT1-9) which this pattern alone cannot express.

ProfileGameID.description: Local identifier for a game entry within a profile (model.ProfileGame.ID), e.g. "steam:123" or "retro:n64:example-game". internal/profile only requires this to be non-empty and unique within the profile — it is free-form and, unlike SafeId, may contain characters such as ":".

Slug.description: Lowercase slug used for stores, retro systems, and directory segments.

SymbolicPath.description: A root-relative path using a symbolic root token (e.g. "${INBOX}/...", "${LIBRARY}/..."). Never an absolute device path, drive letter, home directory, or account-specific segment.

SafeRelativeSegment.description: A relative path/stem accepted by internal/profile.safeRelativePath and internal/manifest.safeRelativePath: non-empty, forward slashes only, no NUL, drive prefix, absolute path, or parent traversal segment.

Extension.description: Bare file extension without a leading dot, e.g. "png", "pdf". internal/profile validates this case-insensitively against ^[a-z0-9]{1,8}$ after lowercasing, so any 1-8 character alphanumeric value is accepted regardless of case.

AssetRole.description: Semantic role an asset plays in presentation. Matches the exact vocabulary enforced by internal/profile's assetRoles set (profile.schema.json's games[].assets keys); distinct from media type/format.

AssetRef.description: Reference to canonical, content-addressed asset content by exact-byte SHA-256, plus the role it is being used in at the point of reference.

GameRef.description: Canonical game identifier (directory slug under library/games/**). Used only by game.schema.json / retro-release.schema.json / playnite-mapping.schema.json / source.schema.json / catalog.schema.json, which describe a forward-looking canonical game registry not yet backed by any Go type in internal/model — see schemas/v1/README.md's status column. The already-implemented profile model (canonical-profile.schema.json / model.Profile) instead embeds identity per game entry via ProfileGameID + identities/retro, not a separate game record.

StoreId.description: PC storefront identifier, e.g. steam, gog, epic, ea, ubisoft, itch, humble, other.

SystemId.description: Retro logical system identifier, e.g. snes, genesis, ps1, gba.

RetentionOutcome.description: Retention/promotion outcome. Matches internal/policy's validModes exactly and is used as PolicyFile.default and PolicyRule.mode (policy.schema.json). Precedence when multiple rules could match one item is asset > role > system > source > global (internal/policy.specificity), with PolicyFile.default as the global fallback.

ModAssignment.description: A single game's selected mod set (model.ProfileMod / model.DeckyModV1: {game, set}). The generated Decky v1 ABI (decky-profile-v1.schema.json) strictly enforces at most one entry per "game" value in its mods array (internal/decky.Validate); canonical profile mods (canonical-profile.schema.json) follow the same convention but internal/profile.Validate does not currently re-check it.

game.description: Game identifier this mod selection applies to.

set.description: Name of the mod set applied to the game. A complete set replaces prior selections for that game entirely (no partial/merge semantics).

Provenance.description: Where a piece of data came from and how it entered the tree. Not yet backed by a Go type; used by asset.schema.json.

importedBy.description: Sanitized actor label (adapter or tool name), never an account ID or personal identifier.

License.description: Explicit licensing statement. At least one of spdxId or name must be present. Not yet backed by a Go type; used by asset.schema.json.
